**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Permit standalone updates of an older composed hook**

When the Lenovo declaration is unchanged but the framework's `pre-push` source advances, the installed hook still contains the previous valid base and therefore necessarily differs from `payloads["pre-push"]`; this guard returns an error before `atomic_write_hook` can install the new base. Consequently, rerunning the documented standalone installer after a framework upgrade leaves the old hook installed—the included test only exercises an upgrade through `_ensure_hook_advisory` first, which masks this path. Distinguish a valid prior composition from an unknown consumer mutation so the standalone end-to-end update remains usable.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L169-L175](https://github.com/Gavin0099/ai-governance-framework/blob/663d13d2a5bb5e241e7879f864b9d2ebff26ff14/AGENTS.md#L169-L175)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Anchor the memory record to reachable history**

When this commit is fetched without the local `work` branch, the recorded `688b3a69` object is unavailable: it is not an ancestor of `8b3c2b9` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` returns 1), and the only current ref containing it is `refs/heads/work`. Consequently, a fresh checkout cannot resolve this supposedly `bound` memory record or its receipt’s matching `linked_commit`, defeating the durable provenance that these fields are meant to provide; preserve the implementation commit in the published history or add a corrective record anchored to a reachable commit.
